status_note: Provisional development manifest named under Architect ruling Q9. It records one exact candidate tuple so that the tuple can be validated independently. It is not a Qualification verdict, an acceptance, a freeze, a security clearance or a production-readiness statement. Qualification owns every oracle and verdict and has issued none for this tuple. This successor (QGATE-05) repairs source-backed metadata only: digests are recomputed by docs/mvp-recovery/qgate-05/build_successor_manifest.py and checked with --check; no pin, oracle, lock or production file is changed or substituted. It is not a freeze; a freeze requires the Qualification Owner approval record.

hub_lock_notice.statement: The Hub component lock is a historical record of an earlier generation. It is stale, is not a record of this candidate tuple and is not a qualified MVP. Hub draft PR #223 proposes a lock bump and is neither merged nor relied on here. If the lock file changes, its recorded hash no longer matches and this manifest must be superseded by a new dated manifest. QGATE-05 successor note: the lock is re-hashed by the build and the build refuses to run if it moved (R-07). ingress_tree.digest_algorithm: sha256 over the UTF-8 text formed by concatenating, for each matching file sorted by base name, the base name, one NUL byte, the lowercase hex sha256 of the file bytes, and one newline
ingress_tree.git_tree_id_basis: git tree id of tools/mvp_ingress at hub revision c897266b7ce4b921889519087fa8b1863b4302e3 (merge of PR #232), recomputed locally by the validator from file contents; supersedes tree id 3908b61a9fbd0d37de7cdb6017da1758d309cd12 (PR #230 merge) and 512888fbd0b71fe40de137d2f9d51f2d331532fd (e7c7183687e756ccf839435ef2959fcafa126cdf)
ingress_tree.file_list_rule: the validator refuses ANY entry under tools/mvp_ingress that is not one of the 8 expected regular files, including any __pycache__ directory, symlink, subpackage or non-.py file; there is no exception. Run with python -B or PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 so interpreter bytecode is not written there
ingress_tree.launcher_entry_point: python -I tools/mvp_ingress/launch.py --state-dir DIR --socket PATH --control-plane ROOT --runtime ROOT --allow-uid UID (--allow-uid is mandatory and explicit; the ingress refuses to start without it)
ingress_tree.interpreter_requirement_basis: the NC4-03 AST pins require CPython 3.13
ingress_tree.unclaimed_limitation: sys.path shadowing: current-directory, hub-root, PYTHONPATH, user-site and planted-bytecode import paths are mitigated only for the supported isolated launcher form (python -I tools/mvp_ingress/launch.py ... --allow-uid UID; installed packages are trusted except the checked Control Plane / Runtime modules); the former python -m tools.mvp_ingress.server form is NOT covered. Also NOT covered: code running as an allowed uid, the ingress uid or root, tampered interpreter, standard library or site-packages, and the host (Yama ptrace_scope).
